taskPacket.objective: Re-sealing an attempt whose only entry is the node_modules link is a no-op instead of an empty commit that fails the retry.
instructions: sealAttempt's dirtiness probe (scripts/worktree.mjs) excludes exactly what the staging step unstages: the result sidecar directory and node_modules.
A comment beside the probe records why the two must match.
An integration test seals a repository whose only new entries are a node_modules symlink and the result sidecar, and asserts the existing seal is kept: the same sha, and empty against the base.
nonGoals: Changing what the staging step stages or unstages.

definitionOfDone.text: The declared verification commands pass on the sealed tree.
The probe excludes the result sidecar and node_modules, so an attempt with only those entries is not committed again.
definitionOfDone.reason: The verification exercises part of this behaviour at most; reading the change is what shows all of it is there.

definitionOfDone.text: Every change in the diff serves the objective, and none does what a non-goal excludes.
definitionOfDone.reason: The write boundary admits any edit inside the declared files; no command tells a requested edit from an unrequested one.

definitionOfDone.text: Every comment and document the diff adds or edits describes what the code does.
definitionOfDone.reason: No command compares prose with behaviour.

definitionOfDone.text: Every test the diff adds or edits asserts the behaviour its name and the instructions claim, and no assertion is removed or loosened.
definitionOfDone.reason: A loosened assertion still passes; only reading the test shows what it no longer checks.

workerResult.summary: sealAttempt's probe now excludes node_modules as the staging step does; an integration test pins that re-sealing keeps the existing seal.

mutation.description: The dirtiness probe excludes node_modules but still includes an unignored .runs result sidecar, so re-sealing a sidecar-only attempt still tries an empty commit.
